ABOUT TOOTH CUBE DENTAL

Experienced dentists.
Personalized care.

At Tooth Cube Dental in Santa Clara, our team of experienced dentists provides care for children and adults—from routine visits to straighter, healthier smiles.

01

General & Restorative Dentistry

  • Dental exams and cleanings
  • Fillings and cavity treatment
  • Crowns and bridges
  • Gum care
  • Root canals and tooth extractions
02

Orthodontics

  • Orthodontic consultations
  • Braces
  • Clear aligners
  • Retainers and follow-up care
03

Children's Dental Care

  • Children's exams and gentle cleanings
  • Fluoride treatments and dental sealants
  • Cavity prevention and fillings
  • Monitoring tooth development
  • Healthy brushing and flossing guidance
